jobs_results.job_title: Data Analyst (Supply Chain and Inventory Management)
jobs_results.description:
Immediate joiners Preferred with expereince in Supply Chain and Inventory Management


Job Summary
We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Data Analyst with strong expertise in SQL, Advanced Excel, Power BI, and ERP systems to support Supply Chain, Procurement, Inventory, and Vendor Management functions. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in analyzing supply chain data, inventory optimization, vendor performance management, and creating actionable insights to improve operational efficiency and business performance.
The role requires the ability to work with large datasets, develop dashboards and reports, identify trends, and support strategic decision-making across procurement, inventory planning, and supply chain operations.


Key Responsibilities
Data Analysis & Reporting

Extract,clean, validate, and analyze large datasets using SQL and Excel.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and automated reports for Supply Chain KPIs.
Perform root cause analysis on inventory, procurement, and supply chain performance issues.
Provide data-driven insights to support operational and strategic decisions.
Create and maintain KPI scorecards and executive-level reports.

Inventory Management & Optimization

Analyze inventory levels, stock movements, and consumption patterns.
Support inventory optimization initiatives to reduce excess stock and stock-out situations.
Monitor inventory health, aging inventory, safety stock, reorder points, and lead times.
Identify opportunities to improve inventory turnover and working capital efficiency.
Develop forecasting and replenishment analysis models using historical sales and inventory data.

Vendor Management & Procurement Analytics

Analyze vendor performance based on delivery timelines, service levels, quality, and pricing.
Create vendor scorecards and performance monitoring dashboards.
Support procurement teams with spend analysis and supplier evaluation.
Track purchase orders, open orders, lead times, and vendor compliance metrics.
Recommend process improvements to strengthen supplier performance and procurement efficiency.

Supply Chain Analytics

Analyze supply chain performance metrics including:

Fill Rate

OTIF(On-Time In-Full)

Inventory Turnover

Forecast Accuracy

Stock Availability

Procurement Cycle Time

Identify bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions.

Collaborate with procurement, warehouse, logistics, and planning teams to improve operational efficiency.


ERP & Process Improvement

Work with ERP systems to extract and validate business data.
Ensure data integrity and consistency across systems.
Participate in process automation and continuous improvement initiatives.
Support ERP enhancements and reporting requirements.

Technical Skills

Strong expertise in SQL (Joins, CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures, Query Optimization).

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including:

Pivot Tables

Power Query

Advanced Formulas

Data Modeling

Dashboard Development

Strong experience in Power BI:

DAX

Data Modeling

Vendor Performance Management

jobs_results.description:
What Makes Us, Us

Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values  caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what were saying, keep reading!

Why is this role important to us 

The Senior Financial Data Analyst in the Data Management team at SimCorp is responsible for analyzing financial data, identifying trends, and providing actionable insights to support business decision-making. With typically 5+ years of experience in financial data analysis, this role involves overseeing the collection, validation, and reporting of financial data, ensuring that it meets high standards of accuracy, integrity, and compliance. The Senior Financial Data Analyst works closely with internal teams and stakeholders to develop reporting solutions, optimize data workflows, and drive improvements in financial data management processes.

This role combines deep financial data domain expertise with analytical and technical capabilities to support business decision-making, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance. The role is primarily domain-focused (approximately 80%), requiring deep expertise in financial market data, reference data, and data governance, while technical skills (approximately 20%) are applied to enable automation, reporting, and data workflow optimization.

jobs_results.title: Decision Analyst
jobs_results.description:
Embark on a transformative journey as a “Decision Analyst” at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences.



The Portfolio Credit Analytics & Strategy team is at the forefront of shaping Barclays’ unsecured lending strategies through rigorous data analysis and actionable insights. Working closely with senior leaders across Product, Finance, and Risk, the team drives strategic recommendations on Product, Affordability, and Securitization, with a strong focus on analytical quantification. As an in-business function, the team primarily supports the analytical agenda for unsecured lending products, including, but not limited to, Pricing and Limit strategies, ensuring robust decision-making at every turn.



To be successful in this role as a “Decision Analyst" in Barclays UK, you should possess the following skillsets:

Really strong data skills using SAS, SQL & Python.

A decision analyst must possess strong analytical and quantitative skills to evaluate data, identify patterns and trends, and generate insights that support effective business decision-making.

Attention to detail is critical for a decision analyst to ensure data accuracy, validate assumptions, and identify inconsistencies that could impact the quality of analyses or recommendations.

Hands-on experience in developing predictive statistical models, forecasting techniques, machine learning & Risk-Reward models, demonstrating your proficiency in applying advanced analytics to real business challenges.

Solid proven experience in making strategic recommendations through analytics in Unsecured lending (Cards/Loans/Overdrafts), Banking, Retail, eCommerce or pharmaceutical domains.

Decision analysts must demonstrate critical and strategic thinking, enabling them to solve complex business problems, assess trade-offs, evaluate risks, and develop data-driven solutions that optimize outcomes.



Some other highly valued skills include:

Effective articulation and story-telling ability, enabling you to communicate complex analytical findings in a clear and compelling manner to diverse stakeholders.

Strong commercial understanding of unsecured lending products, risk and affordability policy, and the key drivers of revenue, risk, and cost, equipping you to provide strategic recommendations that balance growth and risk mitigation.



You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.



This role is based in our Noida, Candor Techspace office.



 Purpose of the role

To extract meaningful insights from complex data sets, developing robust decision models, and presenting actionable recommendations to stakeholders across the departments. 



Accountabilities

Identification and extraction of relevant data from various internal and external sources.Performing sensitivity analysis and scenario planning.Monitoring and evaluation of the performance of existing models.Development and implementation of data quality control procedures.Building and validation of quantitative models to support decision-making across different business areas.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Analyst to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for analyzing large datasets, developing insightful reports and dashboards, and supporting data-driven decision making across the organization. This role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques, and a passion for data-driven insights.





Essential Duties and Responsibilities:






Data Analysis and Manipulation:

Extract, transform, and load data from various sources (databases, APIs, flat files) using SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy).



Perform data cleaning, transformation, and enrichment.



Conduct exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies.



Develop and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes.





Data Visualization and Reporting:

Create interactive dashboards and reports using Tableau and Power BI.



Develop and present data visualizations (charts, graphs, maps) to communicate data insights effectively.



Prepare and deliver data-driven presentations to stakeholders.





Data Modeling and Analysis:

Develop and implement statistical models and machine learning algorithms for predictive modeling and data analysis.



Perform data mining and analysis to identify key drivers of business performance.



Conduct A/B testing and other forms of data-driven experimentation.





Data Quality and Governance:

Ensure data quality and accuracy throughout the data lifecycle.



Develop and implement data governance policies and procedures.



Maintain data dictionaries and documentation.





Collaboration and Communication:

Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their data needs and translate them into actionable insights.



Communicate complex data concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences.



Work effectively in a team environment and contribute to a positive and collaborative culture.






Qualifications:






Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field.



Experience:

Minimum 2 years of experience in data analysis or a related field.



Strong proficiency in SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy).



Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI) preferred.



Experience with data warehousing and ETL processes a plus.





Technical Skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



Proficiency in SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy).



Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI).



Knowledge of statistical methods and machine learning algorithms.



Experience with data cleaning, transformation, and enrichment.





Other Skills:

Excellent communication and presentation skills.



Strong attention to detail and accuracy.



Ability to work independently and as part of a team.



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.



A passion for data and a desire to learn new technologies.

jobs_results.title: Data Analyst ( Marketing Analyst)
jobs_results.description:
About the Role
We are looking for a Marketing Analyst to join our marketing & lead analytics team at Fintech Cloud.
The role involves validating and analyzing marketing leads, tracking lead-to-disbursal funnels, and reviewing CIBIL/credit bureau reports to assess lead quality across our multi-brand lending portfolio. You will work closely with the Marketing, Credit, and Data Engineering teams to improve lead quality and conversion.


Mandatory Requirements

2-3 years of minimum hands-on experience as a Marketing Analyst / Data Analyst.
Prior experience working in a fintech, NBFC, or lending environment is a must.
Strong proficiency in SQL complex joins, window functions, query optimization on large datasets.
Strong proficiency in Python Pandas, NumPy, and standard data manipulation/reporting workflows.
Advanced Excel pivot tables, VLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, array formulas.

Lead Analytics & Domain Skills

Hands-on experience reading and interpreting CIBIL / credit bureau reports to assess lead/applicant quality.
Strong experience with validation of leads identifying duplicate, fraudulent, or low-quality leads before they enter the funnel.
Understanding of the lead-to-disbursal funnel — source-wise, brand-wise, and stage-wise conversion tracking.
Ability to build source-wise performance reports comparing marketing spend against lead quality and conversion.
Familiarity with Metabase or similar BI tools for lead funnel dashboards is a plus.
Working knowledge of GCP/BigQuery for querying large-scale lead and application data is a plus.
Strong attention to detail and ability to spot anomalies/patterns across large volumes of lead data.

Key Responsibilities

Validate incoming leads daily — check CIBIL reports, flag duplicates/fraud, and route quality leads to the sales/credit funnel.

Track lead-to-disbursal conversion across brands, sources, and campaigns.

Build and maintain lead funnel and source-performance dashboards in Excel/Metabase.

Write SQL queries to pull, clean, and analyze lead and application data at scale.

Share regular insights with the Marketing team on lead quality trends and campaign ROI.

Coordinate with Credit/Risk teams on rejection reasons and feedback loops to improve lead sourcing.


Good to Have

Exposure to Power BI or similar visualization tools.
Understanding of RBI NPA/DPD bucketing norms and basic credit risk concepts.
Prior experience in a startup or fast-paced lending/NBFC environment.
